title: 15.40. Cetasikaduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Cetasikaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacetasiko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Cetasikaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacetasiko naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Acetasikaṁ abyākataṁ dhammaṁ paccayā naacetasiko naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
